subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107450 land first and be consumed by this PR, or should this PR remain the single monolithic landing vehicle and supersede that split dependency?
rationale: Both open PRs contain or establish the same dispatch-accounting boundary, and only maintainers can choose the canonical merge order without creating duplicate ownership or invalidating reviewed proof.

options.title: Land Dependency First
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107450, rebase this PR to remove the duplicate transport slice, and rerun integrated current-head recovery proof.

options.title: Land This PR Monolithically
options.body: Keep the dispatch boundary inside this PR, complete current-head validation, and close the smaller overlapping PR as superseded after merge.

options.title: Resume The Full Split
options.body: Pause this broad PR and recreate the remaining closed split stages as independently landable changes, accepting additional review and integration delay.

recommendation.title: Land Dependency First
recommendation.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107450, rebase this PR to remove the duplicate transport slice, and rerun integrated current-head recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the latest current-main adoption force-push and are best positioned to choose the final landing order for the overlapping branches.
